subject: tr-info
title: (R)TR.INFO.------PROJ.DY.
description: Diagram in UPB(II)-8, paired with v1-p146-1. (R)TR-INFO — the reality of trans-information — is crossed with PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). The diagram poses what *real* trans-information (as distinct from any specific transmitted content) looks like when crossed with projectional dynamics. Besides the main line to PROJ-DY, two branches leave the subject. RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits) carries POL-P (political policies), which branches to LANG-DY (language dynamics) and to SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) → POST (postulation). UPB (underlying philosophical basis) carries T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) → WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle).
